prompts.name: Visão geral
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / style-transfer. Use the provided Suporte TI Gráfico dashboard image as the STYLE REFERENCE. Preserve its sober modern monitoring-dashboard aesthetic: ink navy and graphite surfaces, refined thin slate borders, azure primary accent, teal secondary accent, crisp Segoe UI Variable-like typography, consistent line icons and small rounded cards. Create ONE polished responsive UI design board for ONE menu of this real Windows desktop technical-support application, not a generic website.

The user selected this monitoring-dashboard style but explicitly wants LESS information at once, especially on smaller screens. This requirement is crucial: progressive disclosure, generous legibility, clear visual hierarchy, limited summary information. Do not simply shrink everything. Do not recreate the overloaded reference dashboard on every page. Tailor the content to the selected task.

Composition: one landscape design board, approximately 1800x1100 or similarly wide high-resolution canvas. TWO fully visible front-facing WINDOWS APP WINDOWS on the same board. A larger wide-window design on the LEFT occupies about 62% of the board; a narrower compact desktop-window design on the RIGHT occupies about 35%. The compact window is a SMALL DESKTOP WINDOW, not a mobile phone, and its text must remain large and readable. Use the same font size in spirit rather than miniaturising the wide layout. The two windows may differ in height to fit their natural content. Never overlap or crop windows. Plain subdued dark background and very small captions above the windows "Janela ampla" and "Janela compacta". No perspective, no monitor hardware, no browser URL bar, no sales marketing.

Both windows have a native-looking title bar "Suporte TI Gráfico", a consistent simple blue monitor/pulse icon beside it, and Windows minimize/maximize/close controls. Wide window: slim left navigation with icons and labels "Visão geral", "Hardware", "Rede", "Windows", "Impressão", "Contas e políticas", "Relatórios", with "Configurações" at the bottom. Compact window: collapse navigation to a narrow icon rail with a hamburger button; selected section remains identifiable in the page title. Search becomes a search icon/button rather than a large empty text field. Top tabs remain ONE stable row with a "Mais" overflow affordance when necessary, never multi-row tabs that change order.

Use a single page title, short helper copy only when useful, no duplicate oversized headings. Compact layout reduces columns and hides secondary details under clearly labelled expandable rows, never clips critical actions or warnings. At most 2 or 3 key cards visible together; avoid a metric-card wall. Context-specific actions, consistent high contrast, no tiny fonts, no cyan glow, no glass blur, no excessive shadows. Demonstrate a genuine adaptive reflow rather than a scaled screenshot. A subtle scrollbar is acceptable if needed, but nothing important is awkwardly cut off. No fictional health score or unsupported green "all healthy" badges. Keep sample data plausible and clearly illustrative.

Put a small bottom-board footer "Conceito visual · dados ilustrativos". Add a small board label identifying the numbered menu. This is an unimplemented concept, not a real diagnostic result.
MENU 1 — "Visão geral", active in left navigation. Board label "01 · Visão geral".
Wide layout: page title "Visão geral", helper "Resumo do computador e atalhos de atendimento". One tasteful system-summary card with "Estação local", "Windows 11", "16 GiB de RAM", "SSD de 512 GiB", and a single primary "Consultar computador" button. Below, a restrained 2x2 group of useful task shortcuts "Monitor ao vivo", "Saúde dos discos", "Testes de rede", "Diagnóstico de impressão", with small consistent icons and a very short description each. One concise expandable row "Último resultado" with "Consulta do sistema · 14:32". No network speed graphs or four unrelated KPI panels on this overview. A small explanatory status "Informações atualizadas após consultar". Compact layout: the same summary becomes vertical, only essential Windows/RAM information shown, remaining specifications behind "Ver especificações". The primary action stays clearly visible. Show only two main shortcut cards and an expandable "Mais ferramentas". The last result remains collapsed. Visually premium, welcoming, calm and immediately understandable; do not fill all available space with extra widgets.

MENU 3 — "Rede", active in navigation. Board label "03 · Rede".
Main page title "Velocidade da internet". One short line "Mede download, upload e latência até o servidor de teste". Context tabs "Conexão", "Testes", "IPv4", with Testes selected. Keep a visible test button, a visible save-log button and the data-consumption notice. No unrelated adapter lists, CPU charts or status counters. Do not make upload the only big number.
